description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard, specifically handling sale-related functionalities such as displaying sales data, saving settings, and providing sales metrics via API endpoints.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for the sales dashboard extension in the OpenCart admin panel, managing display and update of sales dashboard data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial page load for the sales dashboard, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary models and views, and rendering the sale form page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the dashboard sale extension via POST data, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the dashboard data, including sales statistics, percentage changes, and links to detailed sales pages, formatted as a view.
